title: Gaussian hyperplane rounding
statement: Let $U_v\\in\\mathbb{R}^n$ be a vector for each vertex $v\\in\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and let $g\\in\\mathbb{R}^n$. The Gaussian rounding of this assignment labels $v$ by true exactly when $\\langle U_v,g\\rangle\\ge 0$, and by false otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A vector U_v in EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) for each v
